title: Yara and the Border
author: Ivo Coldharbour
blurb: Emrys Zhou, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
